title: Hearing Emil Helmicke's bass drum at the circus
summary: Aunt Mattie took him to the Ringling Brothers circus where the bass drum of Emil Helmicke hit him in the stomach; she then bought him a drum.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: So Aunt Mattie took you to the circus when you were a little boy?
I heard - I felt this bass drum. This was Mr. Emil Helmicke, the greatest bass drum player that ever lived. He was the highest paid man -

Helmicke, that later on played with the Goldman band up in Central Park. The last time I saw him Max Roach Art Blakey, he was 86 years old. I took ____, I took Blakey, I took Joe Harris out to hear this man play this bass drum. He was the highest priced man in the band at Central Park. The bass drum hit my stomach and I never relinquished that feeling. That was my indoctrination to music. I couldn't keep still; my aunt Mattie held me in her arms. That's when she went and bought me a drum.
